release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.2 restores the 174-scenario preflop raise-size selector. On a live HERO preflop raise decision, the dedicated 174 RAISE SIZE button opens only legal chart-derived sizes for the current position, action history, and hand class. Selecting a size updates the amount field and slider without submitting the raise. Postflop sizing controls are unchanged. The update package retains legacy-updater-compatible Python transport for the original 174 bitmap.
